tasks.title: Conversation #99
tasks.transcript:
Man: Are you going to the technology workshop on Saturday?
Woman: Yes, I am. I heard they'll be discussing the latest trends in artificial intelligence.
Man: That sounds fascinating. Do you know what time it starts?
Woman: It starts at 10 a.m. I plan to arrive early to get a good seat.
Man: Great, I'll see you there.

questions.stem: What event are the speakers discussing?
questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：说话者在讨论什么活动？ 定位原文：Man: Are you going to the technology workshop on Saturday? 选项分析： A. A cooking class 烹饪课。对话中未提及烹饪，所以A选项错误。 B. A music concert 音乐会。对话中未提及音乐，所以B选项错误。 C. A technology workshop 技术研讨会。男士明确提到“technology workshop”，所以C选项正确。 D. A book signing 签售会。对话中未提及书籍或签售，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What topic will be discussed at the workshop?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：研讨会上将讨论什么话题？ 定位原文：Woman: I heard they'll be discussing the latest trends in artificial intelligence. 选项分析： A. Cloud computing 云计算。对话中未提及云计算，所以A选项错误。 B. Artificial intelligence 人工智能。女士明确说将讨论人工智能的最新趋势，所以B选项正确。 C. Cyber security 网络安全。对话中未提及网络安全，所以C选项错误。 D. Mobile app development 移动应用开发。对话中未提及应用开发，所以D选项错误。
